name: Siemens HVDC PLUS modular multilevel converter
description: Siemens implemented modular multilevel voltage-source conversion in a commercial high-voltage direct-current transmission system at Trans Bay Cable. The same product family was later supplied to Viking Link.

date.basis: CAISO gives the effective date of commercial market availability and operational control.

events.statement: Trans Bay Cable began commercial operation between Pittsburg and San Francisco with Siemens HVDC PLUS modular multilevel voltage-source converters.

events.statement: Viking Link began commercial power transfer between Bicker Fen in Great Britain and Revsing in Denmark using Siemens HVDC PLUS modular multilevel voltage-source converters at both ends.
